purpose: Add immutable notification templates, producer-scoped intent idempotency, recipient snapshots, preference decisions, and in-app notification state.
applicationCompatibility: Additive; existing applications are unaffected until Notification Center is composed.
lockImpact: Creates a new schema, tables, and indexes only; no existing application table is locked.
recovery: Before consumers start, restore the pre-deployment backup. After use, preserve notification and audit history and forward-fix; do not drop accepted intent or read-state facts.
forwardFix: Append a new globally numbered migration. Never modify this migration after deployment.
